args.sql: select type, count(*) from products group by 1;
select table_name, column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_name in ('items','orders','products')

with o as (select o.id, max(case when p.type='beverage' then 1 else 0 end) b, max(case when p.type='jaffle' then 1 else 0 end) j, max(case when p.sku is null then 1 else 0 end) unk
from orders o join items i on i.order_id=o.id left join products p on p.sku=i.sku
where o.ordered_at>='2025-01-01' and o.ordered_at<'2026-01-01' group by o.id)
select case when b=1 and j=1 then 'both' when b=1 then 'beverages only' when j=1 then 'jaffles only' else 'other' end mix, count(*) n, count(*)/sum(count(*)) over () share, sum(unk) from o group by 1 order by 1

with o as (select o.id, max(case when p.type='beverage' then 1 else 0 end) b, max(case when p.type='jaffle' then 1 else 0 end) j, max(case when p.sku is null then 1 else 0 end) unk
from orders o join items i on i.order_id=o.id left join products p on p.sku=i.sku
where o.ordered_at>='2025-01-01' and o.ordered_at<'2026-01-01' group by o.id)
select case when b=1 and j=1 then 'both' when b=1 then 'beverages only' when j=1 then 'jaffles only' else 'other' end mix, count(*) n, count(*)/sum(count(*)) over () as shr, sum(unk) u from o group by 1 order by 1
